svg.text: Actual NIFTY index candles | Times IST, start labels | A frozen, B author-corrected, C gap-candle candidate | Ledger overlays only
5-minute: full previous session + full current session
1-minute: first hour; only first five rows form the ORB candle
Opening O 23923.90 H 23940.55 L 23889.25 C 23933.00; body 17.74% | Manual direction / level / entry price UNKNOWN.
Gold band: first 5m. Purple: PDH/PDL. Orange: assumed inner levels. Dashed teal/magenta: assumed LONG/SHORT trendlines. Circles: ledger fills. Crosses: ledger leg exits.
Ledger exits are model fills; on target gaps the existing model keeps the target level, which can lie outside that minute bar.
LONG Method 1: previous_level_close; signed close distance -76.10
LONG Method 2: inner_close, trendline; signed close distance -9.60
LONG Gap/200DMA: gap_crossing; signed close distance 278.16
SHORT Method 1: previous_level_close, trend, quality; signed close distance -114.95
SHORT Method 2: inner_close, trend, trendline, quality; signed close distance -50.40
SHORT Gap/200DMA: gap_direction, gap_crossing, ma_close, quality; signed close distance -278.16
